req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that any 'id' field supplied in the PUT body is ignored and the task addressed by the URL path is the one mutated. Tests must verify: (1) positive — a PUT with a conflicting id in the body still returns 2xx and the URL-addressed task is updated, not the body-id task; (2) negative — the body id does not cause the URL-addressed task to disappear or the wrong task to be mutated; (3) boundary — supplying an id that matches a different existing task in the body still leaves both tasks intact with correct data. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact field values on both the target task and the task whose id was supplied in the body, and verifying the original task at the URL is the one changed.

tests.name: test_put_body_id_ignored_url_task_is_updated
preconditions: Task id=5 exists with title='Write project report', completed=false
actions: GET /tasks/5 to verify the update landed on task 5
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_body_id_ignored_url_task_is_updated():
    r = client.put("/tasks/5", json={"title": "Updated Title", "completed": True, "id": 99})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 5
    assert body["title"] == "Updated Title"
    assert body["completed"] is True
    r2 = client.get("/tasks/5")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body2["id"] == 5
    assert body2["title"] == "Updated Title"
    assert body2["completed"] is True

tests.name: test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_other_task
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', completed=false
Task id=10 exists with title='Organize desk', completed=false
actions: GET /tasks/10 to confirm task 10 was NOT mutated
GET /tasks/7 to confirm task 7 WAS mutated
expected: GET /tasks/10 still returns title='Organize desk' and completed=false
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_other_task():
    r = client.put("/tasks/7", json={"title": "Patched", "completed": True, "id": 10})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 7
    assert body["title"] == "Patched"
    assert body["completed"] is True
    r10 = client.get("/tasks/10")
    assert r10.status_code == 200
    b10 = r10.json()
    assert b10["id"] == 10
    assert b10["title"] == "Organize desk"
    assert b10["completed"] is False
    r7 = client.get("/tasks/7")
    assert r7.status_code == 200
    b7 = r7.json()
    assert b7["id"] == 7
    assert b7["title"] == "Patched"
    assert b7["completed"] is True

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id
actions: GET /tasks/5 to confirm task 5 was not mutated
expected: GET /tasks/5 returns original title='Write project report'
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id():
    r = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Ghost", "id": 5})
    assert r.status_code == 404
    r5 = client.get("/tasks/5")
    assert r5.status_code == 200
    b5 = r5.json()
    assert b5["id"] == 5
    assert b5["title"] == "Write project report"
    assert b5["completed"] is False
